cgst_amount._comment: N201. Invoice.items' head expression, round(taxable_amount * rate / 100, 2), with taxable_amount = amount: this document has no tax-inclusive pricing. engine/gst_documents.py fills the rates from tax_percentage on a GST tenant, so line tax reaches total_tax exactly as on the invoice this document becomes.

role.description: What this party IS to the business. A school's parent is a `guardian`, not a `customer`; a clinic's referring GP is a `referrer`, not a `partner`. Three agents building school and clinic data had to file parents and GPs as `customer`/`partner` because nothing else fitted — and terminology renames Party to Student, so a mother appeared under a "Student" label.
